judge_overbuilt_but_valuable.judge_overbuilt: Custom Apex outcome email instead of approval final-action email alerts
judge_overbuilt_but_valuable.audit_item: Apex managed sharing (row cause Manager_Decision, Edit) written from a without-sharing class instead of a plain manual share
judge_overbuilt_but_valuable.for: The request needs the manager to decide on a private row. An Apex-managed share survives an owner change, while a manual share is dropped when the owner changes. System mode also lets an employee without share rights grant it. The manager stays 'their manager' for the life of the row.
